items.name: Xing4.1-Preview
items.summary: China Telecom's Xingchen AGI Lab released the open weights of Xing4.1-Preview on November 23, a 285B-parameter mixture-of-experts model for agentic coding and long-horizon work, trained entirely on Huawei Ascend chips and published under Apache 2.0.
items.plain: A large open AI model for coding and multi-step office work that a business can download, inspect and run on its own infrastructure.

items.name: Sarvam-105B-1711
items.summary: Sarvam AI released Sarvam-105B-1711 on November 22, a new open-weight checkpoint of its 105B model built for high-volume customer support, voice agents and agentic tasks, with much stronger instruction following, tool calling and Indian-language performance than its February release.
items.plain: An Indian-built open AI for customer support and voice agents that handles Indian languages well and can run on a company's own premises.

items.name: Inkling 2 Mini
items.summary: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Mini on November 20, a 26.4B-parameter open-weights looped mixture-of-experts model small enough to run on a laptop, leading comparable open models on agentic coding benchmarks.
items.plain: A capable open AI that runs on a laptop, so teams can use AI coding and research help offline and keep their data on their own machines.

items.name: GPT-Live-1.1
items.summary: OpenAI made GPT-Live-1.1 available in its API on November 19-20, a full-duplex voice model that listens while it speaks, with more natural multilingual accents, better transcription and a new standby mode that cuts idle voice-session costs.
items.plain: OpenAI's voice AI for phone and app assistants that hold natural spoken conversations, now cheaper to keep connected for customer calls.

items.name: NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge
items.summary: NVIDIA's Alpamayo 2 Edge is a 2B-parameter open reasoning vision-language-action model for autonomous driving that plans trajectories and explains them in real time on DRIVE AGX Thor in-vehicle hardware, with weights published on Hugging Face.
items.plain: A small open AI that lets vehicles plan their driving and explain their decisions, built to run inside the car rather than in a data centre.
